answer_1.quote: We evaluate the RepCodec tokens in downstream tasks of speech understanding and generation. Specifically, we use a decoder-only ASR modelling task to evaluate the speech understanding of RepCodec tokens, and a unit-to-speech generation task to measure the quality of RepCodec tokens for speech generation.
